verdict.line: You lose lane if you facetank his autos and let Darkness Rise proc every trade; you win it by disengaging with E and only all-inning once his W (Indestructible) shield is down and your Q has stacked the pull.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser has no gap-closer besides E's pull and nothing to punish a disengage, while your W (Path Maker) charge blunts his Q burst and your E (Footwork) lets you refuse every trade he wants to take. This lane is decided by whether you fight on his terms (W shield up, passive proc'd) or force fights on your terms (2 Q stacks, his W down).

theirWindow.when: Darkness Rise proc'd and his W up
theirWindow.what: Don't trade face-to-face here; the damage aura, move speed, and a full shield make short trades unwinnable. Disengage with E (Footwork) and reset the wave instead.

yourWindow.when: His W just consumed, your Q stacked
yourWindow.what: All-in immediately: land your second Q (Ntofo Strikes) for the shockwave pull-in, follow with W (Path Maker)'s charge-and-stun, and burst before his W comes off cooldown.

start.why: The flat damage block from champion hits blunts his single-target Q and repeated autos, letting you hold lane through his poke without spending sustain.

boots.why: Magic resist and tenacity directly counter his all-magic damage kit and shorten how long his E (Death's Grasp) pull holds you in range.

core.why: Raw HP scaling keeps you ahead in extended fights where his W (Indestructible) is trying to heal him back.
Passive immolate applies your Dauntless Instinct marks for free on approach and adds durable stats that outscale his early burst.
The attack speed slow aura undercuts how fast he stacks Darkness Rise off autos, on top of armor and CDR for your Q/W/E loop.

his W (Indestructible) sustain keeps saving him through your all-ins

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustains you through his poke and extended melee trades, matching his own W (Indestructible) sustain instead of losing the war of attrition.

summoners.why: Flash dodges his E (Death's Grasp) pull setups before he can commit; Teleport lets you reset after all-ins and get back to lane fast since neither ultimate cycles quickly.

playing.title: Bait his Q, save your E
playing.detail: Let his Q (Obliterate) land through minions when possible and hold your E (Footwork) shield for after he commits, not preemptively, so the shield actually absorbs real damage.

playing.title: Punish right after his W
playing.detail: Once he uses W (Indestructible) to heal, it's down for 8-12 seconds depending on rank. That's your window to build Q stacks and commit.

playing.title: Charge W into his all-in
playing.detail: Start charging W (Path Maker) as he closes to melee range; the reduced damage taken during the charge blunts his auto-plus-Q combo before you knock him back.

playing.title: Track his passive stacks
playing.detail: Watch for Darkness Rise proc'ing (3 landed hits) — it gives him a damage aura and move speed. Disengage with E rather than trading into a proc'd Mordekaiser.

playing.title: Chain Q for the pull
playing.detail: Land two Q (Ntofo Strikes) hits to trigger the shockwave that pulls him in, then immediately follow with W's stun to lock the fight in your favor.

playing.title: Don't panic if he ults you
playing.detail: His R (Realm of Death) isolates you from help, but your own R (All Out) transformed kit, healing, and mobility let you win that duel — don't burn Flash on reflex.
